source.note: Latest saved geometry of origami1829-final-vision.blend. World coordinates evaluated in double precision from the saved float32 data.

coordinateSystem: X right, Y up, Z outward toward the viewer. Mounting plane z = 0.
innerRule: inner_vertex = M + 0.75 * (outer_vertex - M), M = midpoint of the base diagonal (right, up)

topology.description: Open triangular shell: right-triangle mounting base (corner, right, up) plus two side faces meeting at the apex. The hypotenuse face (right, up, apex) is open.
